Categories.value: Images with annotations|Gandhi Bhawan|Self-published work|Featured pictures on Wikipedia, English|Featured pictures of Chandigarh|Water reflections of buildings in India|Water reflections of trees in India|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Clouds and blue sky in India|Featured pictures of buildings in India|India photographs taken on 2024-09-26|Fine Arts Museum, Chandigarh

ImageDescription.value: Gandhi Bhawan at the Panjab University in Chandigarh. A modernist building designed by Pierre Jeanneret, the lesser-known cousin of Le Corbusier. The building sits on a raised plinth in a large P-shaped shallow pool, with an angular and curved three-part pinwheel roof, designed to evoke a floating lotus flower. The white colour of the building was chosen so to contrast with the red of the Fine Arts Museum designed by Corbusier, visible on the right. Picture taken after an intense thunderstorm during late monsoon, when the pool was filled with rainwater.

ImageDescription.value: New building at the Hochfranken business park, is to belong to Pharma Stulln GmbH as an external warehouse in Hof. The photo has a three-color trichotomy; the corrugated metal-like façade is highlighted. The photo looks very tidy and almost symbolic. The light cast creates a color gradient on the façade. The blue sky is simple and contains no disruptive elements. Cutting without mesh at the top edge of the building
